This post is from the site I kept at the Courant Institute (2008–2011). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.
:::

:::::: content
I'm glad to say that I'm back at work, both in cyber- and meatspace.

I had let the website malinger in the land of database connection error for a long time, and it turned out all I had to do was start it up again (the server on which it was running had been rebooted for maintenance).

Physically, I'm back in the office after a holiday vacation and a trip to Washington, DC for the annual [Joint Meetings](http://www.ams.org/amsmtgs/2110_intro.html) of the AMS and MAA.  I gave a fun talk about some of the courses I taught at Harvard using the Moore Method style.
